fields.name: hs6
fields.description: First six digits of hs_code (the WCO Harmonized System subheading); blank on 4-digit heading lines. Join key to data/hs6/harmonized-system.csv

fields.name: hs6_description
fields.description: WCO HS 2022 description of hs6, from data/hs6/harmonized-system.csv; blank where hs6 is not in that table (listed in BUILD-REPORT.json hs6_not_in_wco_table)

fields.name: policy
fields.description: Import policy: Free, Restricted, Prohibited, STE, or blank for non-leaf lines

fields.name: condition_text
fields.description: Policy condition text, HTML stripped, otherwise verbatim

fields.name: condition_ref
fields.description: Policy-condition numbers the text refers to, semicolon separated (extracted, may be incomplete)

fields.name: notification_date
fields.description: Notification date, ISO 8601 where it parses, else as printed
